response.overview: Having lost her mother as young woman Rachel quickly became a mother herself, relishing everything that comes with family life. After losing her father, her dog, and her eldest son leaving home she has found herself at a crossroads, feeling stuck creatively. She decided to find a dancer willing to train her to dance again. This film is the story of that journey, not only of Rachel’s but of the young recently retired ballet dancer willing to make himself vulnerable too. When we don’t know the answers sometimes all we can do is physically move and this film charts this journey of discovery and acceptance.
response.title: Stopped
